## What to do, and how long it takes

| | | |
|---|---|---|
| **1** | Revise Sessions 01–03 for **Quiz 1** | 30 min |
| **2** | Read Mansfield (2021), then Gopinath et al. (2025) | 60–75 min |
| **3** | Collect ideal points + IMF extract | 20 min |
| **4** | Self-check | 15 min |

::: {.warn}
The class opens with **Quiz 1** — twenty minutes, closed book, Sessions 01–03.
:::

## 2 · Read

::::: columns

:::: {.column width="50%"}

**Mansfield (2021)**, *International Trade and Conflict*, Oxford Handbook of IPE, pp. 660–671

The debate in eleven pages.

::::

:::: {.column width="50%"}

**Gopinath, Gourinchas, Presbitero & Topalova (2025)**, *A New Cold War?*, JIE 153

[doi:10.1016/j.jinteco.2024.104042](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jinteco.2024.104042) · free as IMF WP/24/76

::::

:::::

| | Annotate |
|---|---|
| **1** | Liberal argument · realist reply · Mansfield's verdict |
| **2** | **Exactly** how the blocs are defined |
| **3** | The target figure: base period, frequency, units |
| **4** | Connector countries — one your firm depends on |

## 3 · Collect

::: {.step}
[Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/LEJUQZ](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/LEJUQZ) → `IdealpointestimatesFP_2026FP.csv` + codebook
:::

::: {.step}
[data.imf.org → IMTS](https://data.imf.org/en/datasets/IMF.STA:IMTS) → exports of goods, FOB, US$ (`XG_FOB_USD`) · annual · all × all · 2015 → latest
:::

::: {.warn}
Ideal points are estimated by **calendar year**, not UNGA session. Log the version (39).
The IMF extract is large: download **before** you read.
:::

## 4 · Self-check

1. The commercial peace in one sentence; the realist objection in one
2. Martin, Mayer & Thoenig: bilateral or **multilateral** openness — which raises bilateral conflict risk?
3. What does an **ideal point** measure? One thing it does not
4. Why could trade between blocs fall **without a single new barrier**?

## Arrive with

::: {.check}
- Revised for Quiz 1
- Both readings done; bloc definition written down
- Data in `data/raw/`, logged
- Team milestone on ZoneCours
- Self-check on paper
:::
